**BLUF:** Mutual long-range drone strikes between Russia and Ukraine intensified overnight into 13 September, with Ukrainian hits on Russian oil refineries in Tatarstan and Krasnodar Krai causing civilian deaths and fires, while Russian attacks struck multiple Ukrainian cities including near the Polish border, producing confirmed civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Houthi forces advanced along Yemen’s Red Sea coast and seized positions near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, adding pressure on Saudi oil routes rerouted from Hormuz. Taiwan recorded baseline PLA air and naval activity; North Korea conducted live-fire drills. All other standing theatres remained quiet in the collection window with no verifiable consequential developments.[[1]](https://www.euronews.com/2026/09/13/russia-launches-more-than-450-drones-in-overnight-attacks-while-ukraine-strikes-oil-refine)[[2]](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/13/ukraine-drone-strikes-kill-four-as-russia-attacks-close-to-poland-border)

## 1. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Euronews, Al Jazeera, Ukrinform and RBC-Ukraine (13 Sep, reporting on overnight 12-13 Sep strikes) stated Russia launched 453 strike UAVs (Shahed-type and others) against Ukraine; Ukrainian air defences neutralised 409, with hits recorded at 13 locations including Stryi (Lviv region near Poland), Odesa/Chornomorsk port area, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kryvyi Rih, Zhytomyr and Kyiv region, causing multiple civilian deaths and dozens injured.[[1]](https://www.euronews.com/2026/09/13/russia-launches-more-than-450-drones-in-overnight-attacks-while-ukraine-strikes-oil-refine)[[3]](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4163638-ukrainian-air-defenses-down-409-drones-used-by-russia-to-attack-ukraine-overnight.html)

[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Russian authorities and Ukrainian Defence Intelligence (13 Sep) reported Ukrainian drone strikes on oil facilities in Nizhnekamsk (Tatarstan) killing two and injuring 12, and on the Slavyansk-ECO refinery in Slavyansk-on-Kuban (Krasnodar Krai), damaging processing units and tank farms.[[1]](https://www.euronews.com/2026/09/13/russia-launches-more-than-450-drones-in-overnight-attacks-while-ukraine-strikes-oil-refine)[[4]](https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/russia-ukraine-drone-attacks-kill-civilians-hit-odesa-port-tatarstan-oil-hub-ptag-2993762-2026-09-13)

[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Ukrainian and Polish officials (13 Sep) reported a Russian drone struck a Kyiv-Warsaw train near the Polish border (Dorohusk-Yahodyn crossing) with no casualties; a separate drone attack near the border briefly disrupted operations.[[2]](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/13/ukraine-drone-strikes-kill-four-as-russia-attacks-close-to-poland-border)

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Reuters (13 Sep) reported Houthi forces advanced along Yemen’s Red Sea coast, capturing Mokha and positions on/near Mayun/Perim Island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait; Yemeni government forces conducted airstrikes in response, with over 82,000 displaced since early September; Saudi Arabia closed a key oil pipeline after a drone attack.[[5]](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/houthis-yemen-advance-leaves-gulf-states-with-uncomfortable-choice-2026-09-13/)[[6]](https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/yemen-conflict-houthis-bab-el-mandeb-strait-fighting-intensifies-82000-flee-ptag-2993924-2026-09-13)

Ongoing Hormuz-related shipping and diplomatic tensions (Iran-Oman talks) continued without new verified escalations in the window.

### INDO-PACIFIC
[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Taiwan News / MND (13 Sep, 11:37 local) tracked five Chinese military aircraft (three crossing the median line) and seven naval/official ships in the 06:00 Sat–Sun period; Taiwan responded with aircraft, ships and missile systems.[[7]](https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6438814)

[OSINT - WEB] Reuters (13 Sep) reported North Korea conducted live-fire drills involving artillery, missiles, drones and multiple rocket launchers on 13 Sep (Saturday drill).[[8]](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/north-korea-held-live-fire-drills-involving-artillery-missiles-kcna-says-2026-09-13/)

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
Quiet in window beyond the Russia-Ukraine refinery strikes and Houthi/Bab el-Mandeb developments noted above. No other verifiable new sanctions, chokepoint incidents or shocks.

## 2. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
Quiet in window. No verifiable active exploitation, state-linked intrusions or regulatory actions with identified victims or actors.

## 3. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window. No verifiable incidents affecting civil aviation, rail, ports, power, water or telecoms.

## 4. UAP/UFO
Quiet in window. No official statements, hearings or document releases.

## 5. FRONTIER AND CONSCIOUSNESS RESEARCH
Quiet in window. No peer-reviewed publications or funded programme announcements.

**Assessment:** The Russia-Ukraine energy-targeting cycle has accelerated, raising the risk of further winter infrastructure degradation and potential escalation near NATO borders; Ukrainian deep strikes demonstrate reach but invite retaliation. Houthi control gains near Bab el-Mandeb compound pressure on Gulf oil routes already strained by Hormuz issues, improving Iran-aligned leverage and likely sustaining elevated insurance/ rerouting costs. Taiwan and North Korea activity remains within established patterns, providing no immediate escalation signal. Evidence from multiple independent outlets (Ukrainian, Russian, Western, Taiwanese) supports these deltas; conflicting casualty figures reflect standard wartime attribution limits.

**INDICATORS AND WARNINGS**
- Further Ukrainian refinery or logistics strikes inside Russia → likely Russian retaliation on Ukrainian energy/urban targets within 24–48 hours → first visible in Ukrainian regional military administration reports or Russian MoD statements.
- Houthi expansion of attacks or control affecting non-Saudi vessels through Bab el-Mandeb → insurance spikes and further Suez rerouting → first in Lloyd’s List or Kpler shipping data.
- PLA aircraft/naval surge east of Taiwan beyond baseline (>15–20 aircraft or major naval concentration) → testing of blockade or escalation → first in Taiwan MND daily report.
- Independent confirmation of exact damage, casualties and attribution for Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries or unreported Russian industrial hits.
- Verification of any unreported incidents or posture changes in quiet theatres (South/Central Asia, Africa, Americas, strategic/space, cyber).

**COLLECTION GAPS**
- Full scope of Houthi control over Perim/Mayun Island and immediate effects on specific vessel transits or Saudi/coalition responses.
- Independent confirmation of exact damage, casualties and attribution for Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and any unreported Russian industrial hits.
- Verification of any unreported incidents or posture changes in quiet theatres.
